translation_provenance.original_text_en: The commonly used PORAP-1N model (model 08) typically requires a 7200M PORAP during release procedures, and its performance generally meets the requirements. When troops are active, they may depart traditionally, and note the speed limit of PORAP. The aircraft ishanded over to the Sanya District Air Traffic Control Center for command, which sets the RVSM (Real-Time Vertical Management System) altitude and instructsthe aircraft toreach the designated position before NUMKU.
translation_provenance.text_en: PORAP-1N is commonly used for Runway 08. Departure clearance usually requires crossing PORAP at 7200m, and performance is generally sufficient. When military activity is present, a conventional departure may be used; observe the PORAP speed restriction. After transfer to Sanya Area Control, ATC instructs a climb to an RVSM level and requires that level to be reached before NUMKU.
